correctness.rationale: Stationary endpoint enumeration establishes the positive finite affine tilt exactly; conditional even-run mass equals a tilted product of two composition binomials. The derivative of the strictly concave entropy profile has exactly one zero; explicit adjacent-weight ratio and Stirling bounds yield a Gaussian local limit and uniform square integrability. The exact TV identity converts its first centered absolute moment into the sharp constant. Rational finite enumeration (276 comparisons) and 5 stabilized asymptotic tests corroborate the algebra; no finite computation is treated as the infinite proof.
